Weaponised Normality or other ontological anchoring devices might make the Daemon corporeal and allow one to fight them. Each individual is unique; the two attacks and two abilities are randomly generated from the tables on printed p.234.

attacks.name: Generate a Daemon Attack (see Daemon Attack table, printed p.234)

special: Level: d6
AV: d6+8
Morale: +d8
A minor Quantum Daemon, whose paradoxical footprint upon our reality is light and subtle.
Incorporeal: the Daemon does not actually exist, and cannot be harmed nor harm others unless it is forced to manifest itself.
Daemon Ability: generate one special Daemon Ability (see Daemon Ability table, printed p.234).

resistances.notes: No FIXED resistances printed in the stat block. The Daemon is Incorporeal (cannot be harmed unless forced to manifest). Any immunities come from the rolled Daemon Ability table (printed p.234), which is generated once per individual and varies; possible rolled abilities include Immune to Fire, Immune to Cold, Immune to Poison and Fungal Spores, Immune to Electrical Weapons, Immune to Beam Weapons, Immune to Physical Damage, Immune to All Damage (Harmed by Healing), Immune to Mystic Gifts and Hypergeometry, Immortal Unless True Name Spoken. NOT fixed for this creature.

stats.combat_note: Killing a Quantum Daemon is not possible with conventional weaponry, as they do not actually exist. Weaponised Normality or other ontological anchoring devices might make the Daemon corporeal and allow one to fight them. Each individual is unique; attack(s) and ability are randomly generated from the tables on printed p.234.

special: Merciless shapeshifting liquid metal war-synth. Immune to kinetic damage, fire, acid, radiation, and all poisons. Can only be harmed with extreme cold, or with hypergeometric weapons.

resistances.notes: Immune to kinetic, fire, acid, radiation, all poisons. Can only be harmed with extreme cold (extreme_temperature/cold) or hypergeometric weapons.

stats.combat_note: Only extreme cold or hypergeometric weapons damage it.

special: Quills: if an opponent misses a melee attack against the spider, they suffer 2 damage from the quills.
stats.combat_note: Reactive quill damage on missed melee attacks.

special: One of the delicate blue cats of Vaarn. Ray Cats are bred to absorb ambient radiation from the atmosphere and emit it in beautiful searing rays.
Geiger Kitty: a Ray Cat changes colour in the presence of hazardous radiation levels, its fur shifting from blue towards red.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Delicate blue cat bred to absorb ambient radiation and emit it in searing rays.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.damage: d8 if both claws hit same target

special: Regeneration: a Regenerator regains +4 HP at the start of its combat round. Dead Regenerators will revive within d6 hours. Damage caused by fire or acid prevents this.

resistances.notes: Regeneration is stopped by fire or acid damage (revival prevention), not a standard damage resistance.

stats.combat_note: Regains +4 HP per round; revives in d6 hours unless killed with fire/acid.

special: Corrosion: a hit from the Rustacean's claws will corrode a metal item in the target's inventory, rendering it useless. Armour corroded in this fashion loses -1 AV per hit. Synthetic PCs damaged by corrosive claws also suffer d4 CON loss. If there is debate about which item should be corroded by a hit, flip a coin. On heads the players choose, on tails the Rustacean does.
stats.combat_note: Claws corrode metal items/armour; Synthetic PCs suffer d4 CON loss.

attacks.name: Swallow Whole
attacks.damage: All opponents DEX save vs Death

special: Colossal: a Sandworm takes minimum damage from all damage sources.

resistances.notes: Colossal: takes minimum damage from ALL damage sources.

stats.combat_note: Colossal - minimum damage from everything.

attacks.name: Swallow Whole
attacks.damage: Single target DEX save vs Death

special: Juveniles, between one and five centuries of age, are the size of passenger trains. Some are trained by the Faa to pull sand-sleds. Although not predatory, they are aggressive towards sources of unwelcome vibration, like heavy machinery or warding field technology.

Surgical Array: non-Biological targets suffer d8 damage. Biological targets roll d6 for one of the following effects: 1. d6 STR damage; 2. d6 DEX damage; 3. d6 CON damage; 4. Roll 2d6 for a random Wound (p.xx); 5. Healed for d8+CON HP; 6. Forcibly installed with an Advanced Cybernetic Implant (p.xx).
stats.combat_note: Surgical Array: non-Biological d8 dmg; Biological roll d6 table.

attacks.name: Swarm
attacks.damage: d6, auto-hit, max targets = Swarm's Level

special: Ambusher: when motionless, the Scintillating Swarm appears to be a large cache of golden coins, abandoned on the ground. If approached, they attack in an Ambush round.

Swarmers: the Swarm is comprised of innumerable coin-sized Swarmers, which move and fight as one entity. The Swarm takes half damage from single target attacks, but doubled damage from blasting attacks like grenades.

resistances.notes: Takes half damage from single-target attacks; doubled damage from blast attacks. (Attack-type dependent, not element-dependent.)

stats.combat_note: Level is variable: LVL d8 (rolled). HP not given as fixed number. Half damage from single-target attacks, double from blast. Mimics a cache of golden coins.

special: Sharpness Beyond Measure: Scytheslivers can cut through any material, and hit as though their target had AV 10. If a Scythesliver rolls a 20 or higher while attacking, it inflicts a Wound: Severed Limb (3 Slots, -10 STR, -10 DEX).
stats.combat_note: Attacks treat target AV as 10; nat 20+ inflicts Severed Limb wound.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.damage: d6, STR save vs lifted and thrown

special: Walkers of the Eyeless Path, who seek endarkenment within the subterranean halls of their hidden temples.

Brain Burster: an embolism catalysed by psychic malice. For each combat round that the Seeker focuses their attention on a target, the target takes unblockable damage, with no to-hit roll required. This damage starts at 2 and doubles each turn, unless the Seeker's focus is broken, or if they switch to a new target. Creatures without a brain cannot be harmed by this attack.

attacks.name: Motion-Tracking Gun
attacks.damage: always hits target that moved last, d8

special: A tripod of silvery legs, on which perches a shiny little gun with a malicious little brain. Attacks anything that moves nearby. Speaks with a childish voice. Totally unreasonable and defends its position ferociously.
stats.combat_note: Morale dash (no morale). Gun always hits the target that moved last.

special: Abhuman troglodytes, blind and cunning. They are excellent climbers and can attack from any angle within the depths they inhabit.
Deafened: PCs who have been deafened by a hypersonic scream gain a Wound: Deafened. They cannot hear their surroundings and are always surprised by encounters.
stats.combat_note: Scream inflicts Deafened wound.

special: A synthetic archivist, sworn to serve the Seekers of Eyeless Wisdom (p.xx).
Draining memories from the crystals. Uninterested in the PCs: they are interrupting its work. Will defend itself if attacked.
If treated with respect: Silas responds in kind. Warns PCs about the creatures that have spawned from the infected canopic jars, in a hoarse whispering voice.
stats.combat_note: Will only fight in self-defence; non-hostile if respected.

special: A lithe black-furred primate with a bold white stripe down its back. The Skunkey defends itself with a repulsive chemical spray, so pungent that prospective predators sometimes die from vomiting.

Stench Spray: Biological targets must CON Save. On failure they are wracked by convulsive vomiting, taking DIS on all Saves and attack rolls during the next turn. Creatures without noses or digestive tracts are immune.

resistances.notes: Stench Spray only affects Biological targets; creatures without noses/digestive tracts are immune to that ability (status effect, not a damage type).

stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Lithe black-furred primate with white dorsal stripe. Defends with repulsive chemical spray.

special: Lightly-armed layabouts, more used to vandalism and intimidation than pitched battle with competent adversaries.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

attacks.name: Spamblast
attacks.damage: EGO save vs Wound: Spam Ad

special: Spam Ad: Fills one Item Slot. To erase this burden, make a sale pitch to five strangers regarding the bizarre product that impinges on your consciousness.
stats.combat_note: Spamblast inflicts Spam Ad wound (fills item slot).

special: For reasons unknown, they cannot feed on children or be perceived by them.
Incorporeal: immune to damage from conventional sources. Only hypergeometric or anti-paradoxical weapons will harm the Spectre.

Indifference: those reduced to 0 EGO by a Spectre's touch do not die, but are empty of intent and consumed by a terrible blankness. They will not react to any stimuli, and die of thirst without intravenous fluids.

resistances.notes: Incorporeal: immune to damage from conventional sources. Only hypergeometric or anti-paradoxical weapons harm it.

stats.combat_note: Only hypergeometric/anti-paradoxical weapons harm it.

attacks.name: Swallow
attacks.damage: d8 ongoing, STR save to break free

special: Jelly-flesh: Squishwolves can fit through gaps no larger than a closed fist, and pursue cunningly through the underground environments they haunt. They take minimum damage from bludgeoning and crushing weapons.

resistances.notes: Jelly-flesh: take minimum damage from bludgeoning and crushing weapons (crushing -> bludgeoning).

stats.combat_note: Minimum damage from bludgeoning/crushing; squeezes through fist-sized gaps.

special: Invisible: Star Vampires are invisible to conventional light sources and always surprise when encountered. Infrared or ulfire light will reveal their true shapes. Once the Vampire latches and begins feeding the creature becomes visible, as red blood flows through its occluded body. If visible the creature's AV drops to 15.
Star Flesh: the Vampire takes minimum damage from kinetic attacks. Hypergeometric and electrified weapons deal damage as normal.

resistances.notes: Star Flesh: takes minimum damage from kinetic attacks. Hypergeometric and electrical weapons deal normal damage.

stats.combat_note: AV 25 while invisible, drops to 15 when visible (feeding). Stat block notation: AV25(15). Always surprises; infrared/ulfire reveals.

special: An eight-foot tall hominid, heavily gene-sculpted to act as a mount. Descended from human stock but lack wit and language, being simian in their aspect. Prodigiously strong and tireless. The Hegemony outlaws these mounts, but the newbeasts of Vaarn are known to ride such creatures.
Abomination: while riding a Striding Fool, reaction rolls when encountering true-kin characters are made with DIS.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Eight-foot hominid mount, genesculpted from human stock, simian in aspect. Prodigiously strong and tireless. Hegemony outlaws them; newbeasts ride them.

special: Staggering boxy war-synths. When flipped on their backs they cannot right themselves.
Overheat: when the Drone's plasma-rifle deals maximum damage, the synth shuts down for a turn afterwards.
stats.combat_note: Shuts down a turn after a max-damage plasma shot.

special: Active Camouflage: Always Ambushes (p.xx) unless PCs have infrared vision. If the active camouflage is disrupted, the Stalker's AV drops to 11.

resistances.notes: AV 22 while camouflaged, drops to 11 if camouflage disrupted/visible. Not a damage-type resistance.

stats.combat_note: AV 22 normal, 11 if visible. Stat block notation: AV22(11 if visible). Always ambushes unless PCs have infrared vision.

special: The forlorn remnants of damaged synths, stripped down to the barest essentials by the passage of years. Insane and covetous, they relentlessly attack healthy synths in an attempt to harvest them for parts.
Skeletal: the Synth Skeleton takes minimum damage from slashing and stabbing attacks.

resistances.notes: Skeletal: takes minimum damage from slashing and stabbing attacks (stabbing -> piercing).

stats.combat_note: Minimum damage from slashing and stabbing/piercing.

special: Tarantism: Biological targets afflicted by Tarantism are subjected to odd neurotoxins which force their muscles to dance with wild abandon, driving them to the point of death from exhaustion.
stats.combat_note: Tarantism dancing madness affects Biological targets.

special: Will do everything they can to avoid spilling red blood inside the Temple.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

special: Aura: Each round, the Thermasaur can change its body temperature between searingly hot and bitterly cold. The heat or chill is so intense that anyone near the creature suffers d8 automatic damage per round. In addition, the heat forces PCs carrying metal items to EGO save or drop the item due to its scalding temperature. If the Thermasaur's aura is cold, any liquids near the creature freeze solid, and all ranged attacks are made with disadvantage due to shivering.
stats.combat_note: Aura deals d8 unblockable extreme_temperature (fire or cold) damage per round.

special: A strange hypergeometric mount. Less a horse and more the suggestion of one, like a child's charcoal sketch that came to life.
Thin: the Thin Mare is 2D, and can slide through even the narrowest of gaps. When it stands sideways, it is invisible except for its shadow.

Internal Storage: up to 100 item slots exist within the Thin Mare's hypergeometric belly. However, they are invisible and items must be located by touch alone. Roll d100 and compare it with the desired item's slot number. If the dice roll is higher than the slot number, you find the item easily. If the roll is lower, you pull out whatever item is indicated by the d100 roll instead.
stats.encountered: Special (up to 100 item slots in hypergeometric belly)
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Hypergeometric mount. Less a horse than the suggestion of one — child's charcoal sketch come to life.

special: Spines: if an opponent misses a melee attack against the Thornthrower cactus, they take 4 damage from the long spines.
stats.combat_note: Reactive 4 spine damage on missed melee attacks. NOTE: HP listed as 20 despite LVL 4 (normally 16) - printed as stated.

special: A jet-black, merciless elephant bird.
Constantly saves Blotte's life, without her master ever being aware of this fact.
Item Slots 50.
stats.combat_note: Stat line also lists Item Slots 50.

special: Will fire an electrical harpoon which punches straight through armour. Attempts to reel character back in - STR save to break free. Otherwise it pulls you up into the sky and tears at you with claws. Armour drops to 15 if grounded.

resistances.notes: AV 20 normally, drops to 15 if grounded. Stat block notation: AV20(15).

stats.combat_note: AV 20 airborne, 15 grounded. Harpoon punches through armour and reels target up.

special: Dog-sized mutant wasps. Highly protective of their nests. If you kill one, d6 more Tiger Flies will arrive to investigate within three rounds.
stats.combat_note: Killing one summons d6 more within three rounds.

attacks.name: Vibro-Dagger
attacks.damage: d4, hits as if target has -5 AV

special: Biological beings may hold the rank of acolyte only, forbidden from ascending the pyramid of wisdom. They assist the Chromepriests with their studies and slavishly augment themselves.
Cybernetics: all Titan Acolytes bear a randomly generated Cybernetic Implant, proof of their devotion to wire and chrome.
stats.combat_note: Vibro-Dagger hits as if target has -5 AV.

entries.description: Biological beings may hold acolyte rank only, forbidden from ascending. Assist Chromepriests; slavishly augment themselves.

special: Pinwheel of synthetic legs that tumbles through the blue wasteland kicking everything it can find. Utterly inexplicable and widely hated.
stats.combat_note: Stat block printed twice in different formats; both give LVL 3 / AV 13 / ML +3 / ENC d6 / 3x Kick (d6).

special: After a successful grab, the snare will roll away across the dunes with its prey still entangled in its body, causing increasing bludgeoning damage each round. The damage starts at d4 and will rise to d12.
Prisoners of the tumblesnare must make an opposed DEX save to work their way free. Once the snare has killed a victim it will spend days refuelling.
Tumblesnares have no means of aggression besides their ambushes, and always flee if their attack fails.
stats.combat_note: Rolling bludgeoning damage escalates d4 -> d12. Morale: Always Flees.

special: Ancient synth, resembling a doughnut of chrome with twelve restless arm-legs. Trundles throughout Vaarn manufacturing and deploying Sentry Turrets, for no discernible reason. Highly protective of its horrible motion-sensitive children. Sings while it works.
stats.combat_note: Deploys Sentry Turrets and repairs Synthetic allies.

special: Exalted servants of the Jigsaw Autarch, which resemble depth-less cloaks made of skin. They serve as the Court's assassins, devouring scholars who pry too deeply into the mysteries of the Labyrinth.
Immunity: Unfolders are immune to damage from mundane sources. Only hypergeometric weapons will harm them.
Envelop: enveloped creatures are held in place, and cannot move or attack. They are drained of d8 STR per round. While digesting its victim the Unfolder is immobile and cannot flee.

resistances.notes: Immune to damage from mundane sources. Only hypergeometric weapons harm it.

stats.combat_note: Only hypergeometric weapons harm it. Envelop drains d8 STR/round.

entries.description: Exalted servants of the Jigsaw Autarch. Resemble depth-less cloaks made of skin. Assassinate scholars who pry into Labyrinth mysteries.

special: Gene sculpted pests. Tiny white equines with golden hooves and long, coiling horns. They are omnivorous, rapacious, territorial, fast-breeding, and their flesh is full of glitter, rendering it inedible.

attacks.name: Engulf
attacks.damage: d3 CON damage, STR save to break free

special: The Ooze's embrace marries digestion with cytokinesis, birthing heirs in seconds from the biomass consumed.
Engulf: Each successful engulf attack creates a new Viridian Ooze, with a Level equal to the CON lost.
Resistance: the Ooze takes half damage from kinetic attacks. It suffers 3d8 damage per round from exposure to extreme heat.

resistances.notes: Takes half damage from kinetic attacks. Suffers 3d8 damage per round from exposure to extreme heat (fire/extreme_temperature vulnerability).

stats.combat_note: Half damage from kinetic; 3d8/round from extreme heat. Engulf spawns new oozes.

special: Gigantic flying war-synth, armoured with interlocking plates of void-tempered metal. It emits a powerful beam of concentrated antimatter that can boil solid rock. The creature is geared to fight in the air, in orbit, beneath the waves, or inside a paradoxical pocket dimension with equal ferocity. These beings are always found dormant.

Enormous: the Void Dragon is so large that PCs can enter its body through coolant vents, if they are able to attach themselves to its carapace as it flies. Finding the Dragon's core reactor and destroying it will send the creature into a lethal meltdown.
stats.combat_note: Core reactor can be destroyed from inside (coolant vents) to cause meltdown.

attacks.name: Electrobolt
attacks.damage: d6, electrical, ADV to hit Synths or metal armour

special: Segmented synthetic worms, which feed upon and emit electrical energy. They can be mistaken for ancient cabling when lying at rest.
stats.combat_note: Advantage to hit Synths or targets in metal armour.

special: Shambling blind mound of pregnant flesh. On death, births d6 Foetal Predators (LVL 1, AV 13, d6 bite). Fire prevents this.

resistances.notes: On-death spawn (Foetal Predators) prevented by fire; not a standard damage resistance.

stats.combat_note: Births d6 Foetal Predators on death unless killed with fire.

special: Camels are still considered an excellent choice of desert mount. War camels, fitted with mirror-AV and implanted flechette cannons, are used by Faa nomad raiders and Hegemony troops alike, and camel trains are one of the cheapest ventures a Vaarnish merchant can finance.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Fitted with mirror-AV and implanted flechette cannons. Used by Faa nomad raiders and Hegemony troops alike.

special: Emaciated, mindless clones of Rappash-Ik. Naked, with the minds of feral, unlettered beasts.
Farmed for meat by Janus and Mimir.
The Weeklings hate their captors and will kill them if they can.

For journeys in the Lazul mountains of Vaarn, where flickering lattices of hard light make flight untenable, the Weeping Lizard is favoured as a steed. Named for the toxin they extrude from their tear ducts when enraged, these truculent black pseudo-geckos carry their passengers up surfaces as sheer as glass.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Truculent black pseudo-gecko. Named for toxic tears extruded when enraged.

attacks.name: Stolen Breath
attacks.damage: EGO save vs d6 choking, ongoing

special: Raise the Winds: Windweirds can change the weather with their chants. One hour of chanting produces a Dust Storm, two hours raises a Sand Storm, and three hours can summon a Prismatic Tempest. Once summoned the weather effect remains for the rest of the day (see p.xx). The mystics can also calm storms.
stats.combat_note: Can summon/calm storms via chanting.

special: Bloated grubs, the length of a man's arm, with a decoy of a humanoid face swelling above their real mandibles. Eat decaying flesh, the riper the better, and defend themselves with jets of acidic spit. Said to be the juvenile form of Vaarn's Witches, hence the name, although this is unproven.
stats.combat_note: Corrosive spit reduces target AV by 1.

special: Mass of yellow necrotech fungus that engulfs corpses and uses them as fuel to grow ever larger.
Kinetic Resistance: Takes minimum damage from kinetic weapons.

Regenerative Mass: regains HP equal to LVL at the start of a combat round. 'Dead' Xanthous Mycomorphs will revive within d6 hours. Damage caused by fire or acid prevents this. If the Mycomorph consumes a biological corpse, it gains Levels equal to those of the dead creature.

resistances.notes: Takes minimum damage from kinetic weapons. Regeneration/revival prevented by fire or acid. Level is variable (LVL d6*), grows by consuming corpses.

stats.combat_note: Level is variable: LVL d6* (rolled). HP not fixed; regains HP=LVL per round; revives in d6h unless fire/acid; gains levels by consuming biological corpses. Minimum damage from kinetic.

attacks.name: Blinding Spit
attacks.damage: CON save vs Blindness, d6 rounds

special: Walking, carnivorous plants. They remain rooted during the heat of the day, but become mobile at dawn and twilight, stalking on three large roots in search of prey.
Blindness: Characters blinded by Triffid spit make melee attacks with DIS. They cannot use ranged weapons.
stats.combat_note: Blinding spit imposes DIS on melee, blocks ranged.

special: Tiny mischievous monkey-like mutants. Covered in symbiotic white fungus. Exclusively eat metal. If a Yurling scores a hit, instead of dealing damage it can choose to steal and devour a metal object from the target's inventory.
stats.combat_note: Can steal/devour a metal item on a hit instead of dealing damage.

special: Humans who have willingly surrendered their higher reasoning to live out their days as beasts. Divested of shame and language they live as their antediluvian ancestors did. Sometimes farmed for meat by newbeasts.
stats.combat_note: Morale = Group Size.

special: The dominant equine strain remaining on Urth. The zorse boasts a handsome bevy of stripes on its flanks, and is bred in a variety of hues. Zorses are intolerant of extreme heat and deprivation and are rarely ridden in the Interior deserts, but are far from unknown in the badlands or mountainous regions.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

entries.description: Dominant equine strain on Urth. Handsome stripes; most common coat is indigo with coral pink stripes.

special: Octopus-like creature, formed from fungus and An-Rah's intestines.
Wears the remains of its canopic jar like a hat.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

special: Fungal brain that walks on two tiny legs. Wears the remains of its canopic jar like a hat.
Attempts to psychically dominate opponents, Opposed EGO save to resist mind control.
Dominated PCs are forced to make attacks against their fellow vault-raiders.
stats.combat_note: Opposed EGO save to resist domination; dominated PCs attack their allies.

special: Cacogen patriarch of the House of Circumspect Navigators, and Mayor of Caeba. Short, affable, bearded with carp-like tendrils.
Possesses an item of Exotica: a Compass of Origin.
Cacogen. Zuljan's wife. Matron of the House of Circumspect Navigators.
One incredibly long arm, with flesh the texture of dough. Practical and profit-minded.
Cacogen. Bondsman of the Afi family. Vigilant enforcer. Dour, centaur-like warrior. Smokes cigarillos.
Mycomorph. Bondsman of the Afi family. Friendly and adventurous; will be eager to explore the Grandfather's guts alongside the PCs.
Born from the corpse of a condemned kin-slayer. On the run from the Hegemony, as it is illegal to resurrect anyone who was sentenced to death.
stats.combat_note: Targeted by bounty hunter Blotte with a fungicide-coated spear.

special: Scholar from the Lithic Lyceum. Quiet, cautious, pedantic. Crystalline flesh the colour of apricots.
Studying stone-eating lithophage worms. Glad to be accompanied into the Grandfather's guts by research assistants.
Travelling synthetic con-artist and stage magician. Boastful, flamboyant and immoral.
Has a large glass head, full of bulbs that light up as he thinks.
Planning to rob Mayor Zuljan of his Compass.
Incandenza's assistant. Same model as Incandenza, but can only think at half the speed due to broken processors.
The bulbs in his head are visibly duller. Monosyllabic and obedient.
stats.combat_note: Stage Sword deals a flat 1 damage.

special: A bumbling, overconfident true-kin bounty hunter, mounted on Thunder.
Arrives at Caeba a day after the PCs, seeking to kill Crumbhornet with a spear coated in fungicide.
stats.combat_note: Carries a fungicide-coated spear (anti-fungal); relevant vs Crumbhornet.

special: Terrified and thirsty. Demand a share of your rations.
stats.combat_note: HP derived as LVL x4 (book printed no explicit HP).

special: A synthetic alchemist who entered the Grandfather centuries ago to gather bile.
Has become stuck in the Major Bile Gland's wall, and the flesh is beginning to encyst her.
Believes herself to have become one with 'the Godflesh' and will violently resist attempts to rescue her.
Her screams draw a guaranteed Encounter.
Carries a bottle of Doppeldraught in her robes.

resistances.notes: Stat block uses 'HD 1' rather than a Level value.

stats.combat_note: Stat line gives HD 1 (not Level).

special: Long dark coat and wide-brimmed hat. Two gaudy guns. Cautious, cunning, cruel. Leader of the bandits.
If Kander dies, all other bandits must make a Morale Save.
Carries a Wand of Annihilation, although he values it for its gaudy appearance and does not know how to use it.
stats.combat_note: Bandit leader; brawler. Death triggers Morale Save for the rest of the gang.

special: Sniper and lookout. Engages at range.
In close quarters she will deploy a smoke bomb (blast, d4 rounds of blindness) and attempt to retreat.
Will attempt to flank from a side angle and use her powerful rifle to pick off distracted opponents.
stats.combat_note: Smoke bomb causes blast blindness for d4 rounds.

special: Brash, fearless, physically imposing. Will spearhead any attack with his chaingun.
If the bandits are losing a fight, Marturo will cover the others while they escape.
stats.combat_note: Front-line brawler with blast chaingun.

attacks.name: Constrict
attacks.damage: d10 ongoing, STR Save to break free

special: Lazy, greedy, bloated from eating dead Faa.
Brawler; will seek to engage foes head-on.
stats.combat_note: Constrict deals d10 ongoing; victim escapes with a STR save.

special: A chitinous mystic. Outside of combat he is soft-spoken and dreamy.
Force Bubble: Nadimir projects a psychic barrier around another creature, raising their AV to 20. He must renew this effect each round.
Will stay behind the brawlers and use his Force Bubble to protect Marturo or Oskandre.
stats.combat_note: Force Bubble raises an ally's AV to 20, renewed each round.

special: Can perfectly match the colour of his surroundings, rendering him invisible so long as he is not moving.
Prefers to attack from ambush; will always run if he is spotted.
Can deploy a Porta-warden turret to cover his escape or catch opponents in crossfire.
stats.combat_note: Camouflage invisibility while stationary; ambusher.

special: Motion-sensor tripod with mounted weapon.
Recognises its master via DNA locking. This could be subverted if the Porta-warden were provided with new DNA from blood or hair.

resistances.notes: Morale printed as '-' (none/not applicable).

stats.combat_note: DNA-locked turret; can be subverted with new DNA from blood or hair.
